title: b10321
description: metal : fix NORM/RMS_NORM for row lengths that leave a partial simdgroup ( #26708 ) ggml_metal_op_norm sized the threadgroup with nth = std::min(nth, args.ne00_t) , which can leave nth not a multiple of the simdgroup size. The kernels finish their row reduction with a cross-simdgroup step where each lane of the last simdgroup reads one per-simdgroup partial sum out of shmem_f32: if (tiisg == 0) { shmem_f32[sgitg] = sumf; } threadgroup_barrier(mem_flags::mem_threadgroup); sumf = shmem_f32[tiisg];

description: mtmd: stop feeding the text stream again during Qwen3-TTS generation ( #26706 ) The reference implementation has two mutually exclusive prompt layouts.
